module.Title: Identify the Operator
module.Teaching: input() pauses the program and collects text typed by the operator.
module.PredictionQuestion: What does input() return by default?
module.PredictionExplanation: input() returns a string unless you explicitly convert it.
module.DebugPrompt: print() only displays text; input() collects a response.
module.RecallPrompt: Collect the operator name with the prompt "Enter operator name: ". Use the exact identifier input.
module.TransferPrompt: Collect a zone name with the prompt "Enter zone: ". Use the exact identifier input.
module.PreviewMessage: The control terminal can now identify its operator.
